_README: TGE distribution config for K613. Total of 'transfers' + 'vestings' MUST equal 100,000,000 * 1e18.
All numeric fields are strings (avoids JSON precision issues for 1e26 values).
Time fields are seconds. OZ VestingWalletCliff: durationSeconds = TOTAL from start (cliff included).
Team '6mo cliff + 18mo linear after' = 24mo total → cliffSeconds=15552000, durationSeconds=62208000.
Replace ALL placeholder addresses (0x...DEAD) with real ones.
LM-Y1-Treasury 'to' MUST be the Treasury contract address (not a Safe). Governance Safe later calls Treasury.stakeForExternalIncentives(25M) to convert into xK613 reward pool.
POL-LP 'to' MUST be the same address as the broadcaster of SeedInitialLP (typically GOVERNANCE_SAFE), since SeedInitialLP pulls K613+USDC from broadcaster.

Public-Sale 'to' MUST be the K613PublicSale contract address (takes the 10% Seed Round bucket from public tokenomics). It must receive the full 10M BEFORE saleStart, or deposit() reverts SaleNotFunded.
See docs/OPERATIONS_SOP.md for the full TGE flow and sub-step ordering.
